# HABITAT

> HABITAT is a Vienna-based agency for social media and communications for premium residential real estate developments. It makes a project's architecture, design and neighbourhood visible online, so buyers can picture living there long before it's finished. Founded and led by Anna Neitzel. Fully handled: the client names one contact and joins one monthly call; HABITAT does the rest.

The website is available in English (https://habitat-marketing.com/) and German (https://habitat-marketing.com/de/).

## Services

- Positioning and launch communications for residential developments
- Original photography and video of the site, materials, neighbourhood and the people behind the project
- Content planning, copywriting and graphic design for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn
- Publishing, routine community management and monthly reporting (engagement, website clicks, enquiries where tracking allows)
- Optional paid promotion: advertising creatives, message testing, campaign optimisation

## Plans and prices (EUR)

- Project kick-off: €4,500 one-off. Digital positioning, visual templates and profile setup, a 90-day action plan; about three weeks.
- Essential: €3,500 per month. 12 posts and 15 Stories per month, a shoot every two months.
- Signature (recommended): €5,500 per month. 20 posts, 4 Reels and 20 Stories per month, a shoot every month.
- Paid promotion: on request. Media budget and third-party costs are separate.
- Monthly plans start with a three-month commitment, then cancel monthly.

## Founder

Anna Neitzel has positioned and launched premium residential developments since 2014, first in Moscow, where she founded and led the agency RUPOR, and now in Vienna. She leads strategy and creative direction on every project.

## Selected references (work by Anna Neitzel and her teams, including through RUPOR)

- Armani/Casa Moscow Residences — launch communications for a branded residence
- Tessinsky 1 — positioning, launch, PR, social media and events; sold out in under two years
- Primavera Riverside Club Town — PR, social media, influencer marketing; among Moscow's top five premium residential bestsellers in 2023 and 2024
- Artisan — social media, PR, events and brand collaborations
- Turandot Residences — PR, social media and event support
- Central Telegraph — heritage redevelopment communications; 60+ media features
- Côte Rocheuse Winery — international architecture PR; coverage in ArchDaily and Wine Spectator
